summary: Both editions were independently reviewed against all five paragraphs of the selected Greek working source. No concrete fidelity defect was identified. Both preserve the mountains–tribes–nations distinctions, the shared name and seal, unity of outlook, mind, faith and love, the virgins’ spirits, and the subsequent self-defilement, expulsion and worsening. The notes disclose the bracketed working readings and distinguish reported witness wording from fully preserved letters without replacing the selected construction. Acceptance is limited to source fidelity and disclosure within the supplied materials; it does not authenticate unseen manuscripts or certify an exhaustive collation.
